verdict.rationale: Kit doesn't document a native, in-app chat assistant, but it does let external AI clients act on a user's account via its official Kit MCP server ('Let an AI client read and write to a creator's Kit account on their behalf' and natural-language prompts becoming real account actions). This satisfies the spirit of delegating tasks to an AI, though it's an MCP integration rather than a built-in assistant UI. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party embedded chat/assistant interface inside the Kit product itself, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP-driven task delegation working in practice.
